record.original_question: Suppose D is an admissible subcategory of Db(X) that admits Serre-invariant stability conditions and has numerical Grothendieck group N(D) of rank 2. Is there a unique orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions on D under the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R)?

evidence.quote: Question 5.16. Assume that D is an admissible subcategory of Db (X) which admits Serre-invariant stability conditions. If N(D) has rank 2, is there a unique orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions with respect to the GL f+2 (R)-action?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth projective variety over the complex numbers, and let D^b(X) denote its bounded derived category of coherent sheaves. An admissible subcategory D ⊂ D^b(X) is a full triangulated subcategory whose inclusion admits both left and right adjoints; such a D has its own Serre functor S_D. A Bridgeland stability condition σ = (Z, A) on D (with respect to a fixed surjection from the numerical Grothendieck group N(D) to a finite-rank lattice) is called Serre-invariant if S_D · σ lies in the same orbit as σ under the natural action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(ℝ) on the space of stability conditions Stab(D).

Assume that D is an admissible subcategory of D^b(X) which admits at least one Serre-invariant stability condition, and that the numerical Grothendieck group N(D) has rank 2.

Question: Is the set of Serre-invariant stability conditions on D a single orbit under the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(ℝ)?
artifact.status_search_result: Uniqueness of the orbit of Serre-invariant stability conditions has been established in several geometric cases of admissible subcategories with rank-2 numerical Grothendieck group — notably for Kuznetsov components of cubic threefolds (Feyzbakhsh–Pertusi), and subsequently for Kuznetsov components of del Pezzo threefolds of degree ≥ 2 and prime Fano threefolds of genus ≥ 6, under fractional Calabi–Yau hypotheses. A fully general answer for all admissible subcategories satisfying the stated hypotheses does not appear to be available in the literature; the question is partially solved in important cases but not settled in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Serre-invariant stability conditions and Ulrich bundles on cubic threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: A fractional Calabi-Yau category of dimension ≤ 2 admits a unique Serre-invariant stability condition up to the action of the universal cover of GL_2^+(R).
status_evidence.claim: Uniqueness of the Serre-invariant orbit is established in a class of rank-2 cases including the Kuznetsov component of a cubic threefold.

status_evidence.title: Higher-dimensional moduli spaces on Kuznetsov components of Fano threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Serre-invariant stability conditions on Kuznetsov components of del Pezzo threefolds and prime Fano threefolds form a single GL_2^+(R)-orbit.
status_evidence.claim: Additional cases of the uniqueness question have been resolved for further families of Fano threefolds.
